app.name: vWii Ethernet Patcher
app.short_description: USB ethernet adapters for Wii and vWii
app.long_description: Patches the ETH module of the Wii / vWii IOS for AX88772B, AX88772C, AX88772D, AX88179 (Nintendo Switch LAN adapter) and AX88179A USB ethernet adapters. Dump your IOS with [+] first. Limit the switch / router port of the console to 100M.
